project_name: Chronic Care AI - Hostel Management System
description: A comprehensive healthcare and hostel management system for chronic disease patients with AI agent capabilities

prediction_room.name: Disease Prediction Room
prediction_room.description: AI-powered prediction system for chronic diseases
prediction_room.how_to_use: Navigate to Prediction Room → Select disease type → Fill required health parameters → Get instant risk assessment
prediction_room.requirements: User must be logged in to access prediction features

prediction_history.name: Prediction History
prediction_history.description: View your previous disease prediction results
prediction_history.how_to_use: Click on Prediction History in navbar → View your prediction timeline
prediction_history.requirements: Must have made at least one prediction

appointments.name: Appointment Booking System
appointments.description: Book and manage medical appointments with assigned doctors
appointments.how_to_use: For Patients: Book Appointment → Select date/time → Add reason → Confirm. For Doctors: View Patient Appointments → Manage status
appointments.requirements: Patients must have assigned doctor, Doctors can see all patient appointments

private_messaging.name: Private Messaging System
private_messaging.description: Secure communication between patients and doctors
features: Send private messages to assigned doctor
private_messaging.how_to_use: Click Private Messages → Compose new message → Send to assigned doctor

community_chat.name: Community Chat Room
community_chat.description: Interactive community chat for all users
community_chat.how_to_use: Click Community Chat → Type message → Send. Use quick buttons for common phrases

medical_store.name: Medical Store
medical_store.description: Online medical store for purchasing medicines
medical_store.how_to_use: Navigate to Medical Store → Browse medicines → Add to cart → View cart

user_profile.name: User Profile Management
user_profile.description: Manage your personal information and settings
user_profile.how_to_use: Click on Profile → Update information → Save changes

hostel_management.name: Hostel Management
hostel_management.description: Manage hostel rooms, allocations, and student information
hostel_management.how_to_use: Access through hostel management section → Manage rooms and students

admission.name: Admission System
admission.description: Student admission and doctor-patient assignment management
admission.how_to_use: For Admins: Manage student admissions and doctor assignments

ai_agent.name: AI Agent Assistant
ai_agent.description: Intelligent assistant with enhanced capabilities for doctors and patients
ai_agent.how_to_use: Access through the AI Assistant chatbot → Ask questions about patients, messages, appointments, etc.

patient.description: Regular users who can access healthcare services
permissions: Use AI assistant for general queries

doctor.description: Superusers who provide medical care and management
permissions: Register new patients via AI assistant
View all assigned patients via AI assistant
